# MED-PC fixture sources

These files are unmodified session files copied from public datasets (only renamed).
They are used to test the MED-PC importer in `session_recorder.medpc`.

| Fixture | Dataset | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `bernardy_training_vi30s_JL4.txt` (VI 30 s training, subject JL4) | Bernardy, J. L. (2025). *Supplemental material: Feedback function and performance on variable differential reinforcement of low rates: Tempus urgit vel abundat?* [Data set]. Harvard Dataverse. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/BXVB2F | CC0 1.0 |
| `bernardy_vdrl10s_JL1.txt` (VDRL 10 s, subject JL1) | same as above | CC0 1.0 |
| `sosa_inh_R6_s13.txt` (session 13, rat 6) | Sosa, R., Mata-Luévanos, J., Tapia-de-Jesús, A., Saavedra, P., & Buenrostro-Jáuregui, M. (2026). *Longitudinal association between different indices of behavioral inhibition* [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19164959 | CC BY 4.0 |
| `mccutcheon_prpr_PPR2.7_FR1_day5.txt` (FR 1, no reinforcers) | McCutcheon, J. (2022). *Progressive ratio in protein-restricted vs. non-restricted rats* [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5409201 | CC BY 4.0 |
| `mccutcheon_prpr_cPPR1.9_PR3_day2.4.txt` (PR, step 3) | same as above | CC BY 4.0 |
